APPROVE
`Files` now sits well below 15 because the loop body only calls `TryList`, `ReadFiles` and `EnqueueRealDirectories`. The helpers keep the original behaviour: `break` still exits only the per-directory file loop, a failed listing is still recorded and skipped, and links are still not followed. The moved `CHA0004` pragma still covers every catch, so the build should stay clean. That assumes the project already compiles C# 12 collection expressions (`[]`), and I couldn't check that because the repository isn't available here.
